description:
Compact language switch: a bordered pill of locale segments, the active
one inverted (foreground on background). Sits next to the theme toggle.

props.name: locales
props.description: The locales to offer, in display order, e.g. `["en", "fr"]`.

props.name: current
props.description: The active locale; its segment is inverted and marked `aria-current`.

props.name: hrefFor
props.description:
Where each segment links to. To keep the visitor on the same page,
build it from the current pathname, e.g. `/fr/how-it-works` for `fr`.

props.name: LinkComponent
props.description: Link component for each segment. Default: a plain `<a>`.

props.name: linkProps
props.description: Extra props for every segment link, e.g. `{ prefetch: false }` for Next.js `Link`.
